headline: US Consumer Credit Rises by $27.8 Billion in September to $5.22 Trillion
summary: US consumer credit increased by $27.8 billion in September, exceeding market expectations and bringing total outstanding consumer debt to $5.22 trillion.
why: Consumer credit metrics track household borrowing behavior, credit card usage, and consumer demand health within the broader economy.

impacts.name: United States
impacts.why: Faster growth in consumer borrowing indicates active household leverage and spending activity.
